## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admiringly takes in the surrounding nature, though she remembers she cannot stay. She eats breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), then offers to do household chores while sharing her imaginative thoughts. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to return her, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently indicates his desire to keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P28](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0028)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to learn the Lord's Prayer, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by her daydreams and imaginations. Eventually, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom where she finishes learning the prayer and continues daydreaming out her window.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she made for her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is disappointed by their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wears a flower-garlanded hat to Sunday school alone. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her miserable experience in Miss Rogerson's class and her honest thoughts on the church service.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers at church, but then offers to introduce her to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). They visit [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly form a deep friendship and pledge to be bosom friends forever. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a delighted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her excitement with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a gift of sweeties.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a picnic basket, prompting a rare, affectionate embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on her sewing, she chatteringly details her playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her growing excitement for the picnic.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers her missing brooch caught in a black lace shawl and realizes Anne's false confession was fabricated just to be allowed to go to the picnic. Apologetic for doubting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her off to the event with Jerry driving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later returns home delighted after a wonderful day.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to get ready for the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after having a wonderful time at the picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and offers them raspberry cordial. During the visit, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drinks three glasses of what they believe is cordial and suddenly feels sick and dizzy, forcing her to go home. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three-year-old currant wine instead, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become intoxicated.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine and refuses to let them play together anymore. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes she put the wine where the cordial should have been and tries to reason with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md), but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) remains unforgiving. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally pleads with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to no avail, leaving her heartbroken, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows a rare moment of tenderness toward the sleeping girl.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away in town, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) seeks help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when her little sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) falls ill with severe croup. Drawing on her past experience caring for twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night before the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the concert and stay overnight at Diana's house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy the performance and return to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) late at night. They run and leap onto the spare-room bed, inadvertently jumping on Diana's sleeping Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, after learning that [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to cut off Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her remorse to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> After discussing the situation with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest explanation and charm amuse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), persuading her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two become close friends, and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) eventually invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her in the city.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on spring events and marks the one-year anniversary of her arrival at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while talking with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the Barrys, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood), making her terrified to cross it in the dark. Unmoved, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the woods as a lesson, curing Anne's desire for haunted places.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home after emotional farewells on the last day of school and learns about the arrival of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She bonds with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) at Sunday school and helps prepare a lavish tea for the couple at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste the layer cake [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) specially baked for the occasion, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reacts in dismay to its strange taste.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table for the minister and his wife, but accidentally flavors her special cake with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified by her blunder, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) follows her upstairs to gently comfort her and invites her to show off her flower garden.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). After worrying about her conduct, she returns from the visit in high spirits and happily recounts the evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), including news that [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has hired a new female schoolteacher.

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of the [Barry](../character/barry.md) kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts it, falls off, and breaks her ankle. During her long recovery at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who is visited by many supportive friends and neighbors while longing to return to school.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). At home, she enthusiastically shares her school experiences and upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the concert's value, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks fashionable clothing like other girls, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a dress at Lawson's store but becomes flustered by the clerk, Miss [Harris](../character/harris.md). He seeks help from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who agrees to buy and sew a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift of elegant slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place that evening, where Anne's recitations are a huge success. Afterward, as they walk home, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) mentions [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) saving Anne's dropped rose, while back at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) proudly discuss Anne's performance and her future education.
>

Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the success and rules of the story club, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the endeavor.

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) expecting supper, but finds the stove unlit and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nowhere in sight. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes upstairs, she discovers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hiding under her pillows because she dyed her red hair green using hair dye bought from a peddler. After washing fails to remove the green color, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair off short, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect remorsefully on her vanity.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact a poem on a flat-bottomed boat, but the boat begins to leak, stranding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) angrily refuses his offer of friendship. After returning home safely, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning another lesson, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages her not to abandon all her romance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) should join. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly accepts the opportunity to study to become a teacher. When the class begins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and realizes she has secretly forgiven him.
>

> As the school term comes to an end, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her ongoing rivalry and hidden regret regarding [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, to her students' delight. At home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs away her books for a summer vacation, and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) praises Anne's growth and character during a visit with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.

Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her grief with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and reminisces with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about past times and Marilla's youthful romance with John [Blythe](../character/blythe.md).

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up heavy eye work or face total blindness, putting the future of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in jeopardy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to forfeit her college scholarship, stay at home to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and take up a local teaching job instead. After learning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so she could have it, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on her way home and they finally end their feud to become close friends.
>

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's past relationship and his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), coming to live in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plan to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) warns will be difficult. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) also shares that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's home to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow, but he receives the news calmly, insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) notwithstanding. After trading cows and sharing tea and cake, the two form an unexpected friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home relieved and shares the outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> On the eve of the school term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses teaching methods and classroom discipline with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), strongly opposing corporal punishment. After returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before starting her first day of teaching.
>

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) begin canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) to raise money for the hall. After facing a grim refusal from [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), they receive a secret donation from [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), assist [Daniel](../character/daniel.md) Blair with baking a cake in exchange for a subscription, and navigate Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to secure another contribution.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their creative efforts, teaching experiences, and ambitions for the future. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home with news that their sick cousin Mary cannot care for the Keith twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take them in for the winter.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing and everyone frantically searching for her. After searching the well and surrounding area with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted and tearfully promises never to lie again after realizing he made [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, though he later questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Marilla's warning regarding prayers.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) why his lie was the dreadful consequence of skipping his prayers, defending Marilla's honesty. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Davy's mischief and Dora's quiet perfection, agreeing that despite Davy's trouble, they feel a fond affection for him because he needs their guidance.
>

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about heaven after hearing a strange explanation from [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gently corrects. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) announcing that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting excited preparations by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare an elaborate meal in anticipation of guest Mrs. Morgan's arrival. After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the remaining guests eat a quiet dinner that culminates in the destruction of Aunt Josephine's platter. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and will not be coming at all.
>

> Following the broken platter incident, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's ongoing plans and school updates. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) her list of tasks for the next day.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where she accidentally dyes her nose scarlet while changing feather beds. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a visit. Despite her initial embarrassment, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful dinner and walk with the guests before they depart.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and gossip about old town affairs while trying to keep [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in check. Later, word arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died and left money in trust for the twins, ensuring that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can remain living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.

> A massive hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted in a lighthearted newspaper note, causing severe damage across the village. The family at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) weathered the violent hail inside, after which they learn that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the storm's destruction and note the destruction of an old blighted house.
>

> An unexpectedly neat woman arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and reveals herself to be his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), before heading over to his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) eventually asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to come over so he can explain the whole story of their separation.

[Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tea, and walks home with her while expressing regret over their past feud. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) affectionately expresses his fondness for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she puts him to bed.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).
>

Before going to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he was tempted to say a bad word, and she gently helps him process it so he can say his prayers.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>

> During a stormy holiday break at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Davy's lively chatter. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail, bringing letters from college friends and news that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a thousand dollars.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has brightened her life when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unexpectedly arrives home a day early from college. The two reminisce and discuss [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), before [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in and excitedly catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up on his latest antics.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits outside [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), talking about the local news, Davy's schoolwork, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling sad about how growing up changes relationships and reflecting on her feelings regarding [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md).

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, where they converse about their summer plans and changing lives.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after her breakup with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She hears updates about local news and engagements from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), serves as bridesmaid for Phil's wedding, and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to meet her newborn baby boy.

Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives well-wishing visitors with mixed comments, after which [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives and tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about the house he has found for their future home.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming guests including [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. While dinner is prepared and served, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia engage in a lively debate to Gilbert's amusement. After a successful meal carved by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), the party gathers by the hearth as Captain Jim shares stories before taking his leave.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she gives birth to a newborn girl named Joyce, but the baby tragically passes away later that evening. Friends and family offer comfort and prepare the baby for burial, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grieves deeply and struggles to find meaning or comfort in her sorrow.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name James Matthew after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia visit to admire the child and celebrate his arrival. Later, Miss Cornelia tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit, and they discuss Leslie's future plans.
>
